Right heart: TAPSE 3.3 cm (normal), TR peak velocity 1.41 m/s = gradient 7.9 mmHg — no pulmonary hypertension despite OSA

ECG + 24 h Holter — reported normal, also pre-flecainide. QRS duration in ms still to be obtained.
